definitions.short: Eljada , the name of two Israelites and of an Aramaean leader
definitions.full: H450. Elyada אֶלְיָדָע proper name, masculine ( God knows , compare דְּעוּאֵל , Sabean אלידע Hal 209 ) a. son of David 2Sam 5:16 ; 1Chr 3:8 = בעלידע 14:7 which perhaps read here, compare Dr Sm. b. father of an adversary of Solomon 1Kin 11:23 = c. chief of Benjamin 2Chr 17:17 .
